name: retry_performance_evaluation
description: Workflow designed to assess how effective retry processing is in recovering transactions that initially failed.
procedure_steps: Retrieve metrics for first iteration successes and failures
Retrieve metrics for retry iteration successes and failures
Compute recovery percentage achieved during retry processing
Compare first pass success rate against retry pass success rate
Highlight markets where retry attempts do not significantly improve outcomes
expected_outputs: Retry recovery or lift rate calculated for each market
List of markets showing weak retry recovery performance
Operational recommendations to improve retry effectiveness
application_context: Operations teams use this workflow to determine whether retry mechanisms are successfully recovering failed transactions and to identify markets requiring process improvements.
